cohort.direction_note: higher s3 => sensitive (protective) per Nature; AUROC positive class = resistant so protective => AUROC<0.5

s3_diag_auroc.interpretation: AUROC<0.5 confirms protective direction (low s3 -> resistant), consistent with Nature

covariate_completeness.note: age/stage/num_lines are present for only 67/98 patients in the published confounder table (figure_2.tsv); the adjusted model therefore runs on 67 patients / 9 events, MORE underpowered than the 20-event unadjusted set. Unadjusted AUROC, BH-FDR and LOEO use all 20 events.

adjusted_logistic.firth_note: Firth-penalized companion (Jeffreys-prior bias reduction); sign and magnitude concordant with MLE => protective s3 estimate is NOT a sparse-data / separation artifact

sensitivity.purity_ploidy_immune_note: Per-patient purity/ploidy/immune-infiltration values are NOT in the published source-data tables used here (figure_4A/1B/2). Nature reports these as cohort-level covariates of CN signatures but does not release per-patient purity/ploidy/immune scores in these files. This sensitivity is therefore reported as NOT TESTABLE with the available open data, not as passed.

leave_one_event_out.note: Small LOEO range => estimate not driven by a single event
